web.title: Instagram Video Publishing Error: Media ID is not available - code: 9007
web.description:
```
"error": {
"message": "Media ID is not available",
"type": "OAuthException",
"code": 9007,
"error_subcode": 2207027,
"is_transient": false,
"error_user_title": "Cannot Publish",
"error_user_msg": "The media is not ready for publishing, please wait for a moment",
"fbtrace_id": "AjM9x8yLwZUBhsc3kfb1XYZ"
}
```

The API returns error code `9007 (Media ID is not available)` even though the media is eventually processed successfully on Instagram’s side.

### Error Details
```
Error response:

{
  "error": {
    "message": "Media ID is not available",
    "type": "OAuthException",
    "code": 9007,
    "error_subcode": 2207027,
    "is_transient": false,
    "error_user_title": "Cannot Publish",
    "error_user_msg": "The media is not ready for publishing, please wait for a moment"
  }
}
```

### Request
#### Could anyone from Meta please confirm:
`{"error":{"message":"Media ID is not available","type":"OAuthException","code":9007,"error_subcode":2207027,"is_transient":false,"error_user_title":"Cannot Publish","error_user_msg":"The media is not ready for publishing, please wait for a moment","fbtrace_id":"AFC5tqtK-YPf9XXC82QCeup"}}`

The real problem is different and not on the /media_publish API.
